<!DOCTYPE html>

<html lang="vi"><head><meta charset="utf-8"/><meta content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1" name="viewport"/><title>Giải mã hiền tài là nguyên khí quốc gia</title><style>
:root{--gold:#e6c57f;--cream:#f1e9d6;--muted:#c8d1c8;--deep:#071a18;--line:#b89452}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#030b0a;color:var(--cream);font-family:Aptos,Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif}
#deck{position:relative;width:100vw;height:100vh;background:#030b0a}.slide{position:absolute;inset:0;display:none;overflow:hidden;background:#071a18}.slide.active{display:block;animation:fade .32s ease-out}@keyframes fade{from{opacity:.3;transform:scale(1.006)}to{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}}
.image-slide{background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(4,17,15,.24),rgba(4,17,15,.08)),var(--bg);background-size:cover;background-position:center}
.panel{position:absolute;left:3.6vw;top:7vh;width:64vw;height:84vh;max-width:1050px;background:rgba(4,18,16,.89);border:1px solid rgba(203,165,92,.55);border-radius:22px;padding:clamp(22px,3vw,46px);box-shadow:0 16px 54px rgba(0,0,0,.28);backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}
.eyebrow{color:var(--gold);font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(10px,.9vw,14px);letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:18px}.tagline{display:block;letter-spacing:.14em;color:#c6cebe;font-size:.84em;margin-top:7px}
h2{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:clamp(24px,2.25vw,38px);line-height:1.18;color:#f5e6bf;margin:0 0 3vh;font-weight:700}
.options{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px;margin-top:2.6vh}.option{min-height:clamp(90px,13vh,132px);display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:14px;padding:18px 17px;border:1px solid rgba(125,154,128,.65);background:rgba(9,30,25,.9);border-radius:14px;color:#f3eddf;font-size:clamp(13px,1.12vw,18px);line-height:1.38}.option i{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;flex:none;width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:9px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#edce81,#a77a35);color:#13231c;font-weight:900;font-style:normal}
.qfoot{position:absolute;left:3vw;bottom:3.2vh;color:#c7cdbf;font-size:clamp(10px,.84vw,13px);font-style:italic}.timer{position:absolute;right:4vw;top:6vh;width:100px;height:86px;border:1px solid rgba(230,197,127,.68);background:rgba(6,24,21,.9);border-radius:16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:2px}.timer .time{font-size:32px;color:#f5db94;font-weight:900;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.timer small{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.18em;color:#cfd3c4}.timerline{height:4px;width:74px;background:#35453a;border-radius:10px;margin-top:6px;overflow:hidden}.timerline b{display:block;height:100%;width:100%;background:#e6c57f;transform-origin:left}
.answer-panel{width:63.5vw;top:6.3vh;height:87vh;left:3.4vw;padding:clamp(22px,2.8vw,42px)}.answer-letter{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:clamp(31px,3vw,49px);font-weight:bold;color:#f1d38b;margin:1.5vh 0 1.7vh}.correct{font-weight:750;font-size:clamp(17px,1.45vw,23px);line-height:1.35;max-width:95%}.rule{height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(209,173,99,.8),transparent);margin:2.5vh 0}.why{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.2em;font-weight:900;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:1.2vh}.explain{max-width:95%;font-size:clamp(15px,1.35vw,21px);line-height:1.55;color:#f0ebdf;margin:0}.answer-foot{position:absolute;bottom:3vh;font-size:10px;color:#bac6b9;letter-spacing:.11em}

.cover{background:#061715}.river{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}.cover-vignette{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(2,15,14,.82),rgba(3,18,15,.5) 43%,rgba(3,18,15,.06) 100%)}.cover-panel{position:absolute;left:4vw;top:12vh;width:min(48vw,790px);height:55vh;background:rgba(5,22,19,.72);border:1px solid rgba(204,166,94,.7);border-radius:22px;padding:3.2vh 3vw;backdrop-filter:blur(3px)}.cover h1{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:clamp(30px,2.9vw,48px);line-height:1.06;color:#f6e3ac;margin:2.1vh 0 2vh;letter-spacing:0}.cover h1 span{color:#e6c57f}.cover-sub{font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(14px,1.2vw,18px);color:#f5e9cf;letter-spacing:.14em}.cover-author{margin-top:3vh;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.24em;color:#bdcabb;font-weight:bold}.goldbtn{border:0;border-radius:13px;padding:15px 23px;background:linear-gradient(140deg,#f1d891,#a87830);color:#17241b;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.04em;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}.cover .goldbtn{margin-top:2.6vh}.goldbtn:hover{filter:brightness(1.1)}.river-caption{position:absolute;right:4vw;bottom:4vh;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.22em;color:#f0d28a;text-shadow:0 2px 8px #000}
.wide{width:67vw;max-width:1100px}.steps{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2vh;margin-top:3vh}.steps>div{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;min-height:65px}.steps b{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;flex:none;width:44px;height:44px;background:linear-gradient(140deg,#f1d891,#a87830);border-radius:12px;color:#12231c}.steps span{font-size:clamp(16px,1.35vw,21px);line-height:1.4}.goldnote{position:absolute;bottom:3.1vh;color:var(--gold);font-style:italic;font-size:12px}.closing .end-panel{width:67vw;height:75vh;top:12vh}.closing h2{font-size:clamp(36px,4vw,60px);line-height:1.12;margin:2.6vh 0 4vh}.closing h2 span{color:#f3d58e}.closing p{font-size:clamp(19px,1.8vw,27px);line-height:1.5}.end-author{position:absolute;bottom:9vh;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--gold);font-weight:800}.replay{position:absolute;bottom:3vh;right:3.2vw}
#chrome{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:10px 18px;background:linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(0,0,0,.64),transparent);z-index:100;opacity:.2;transition:opacity .2s}#chrome:hover{opacity:1}.navbtn{background:rgba(5,22,18,.82);border:1px solid rgba(206,174,111,.6);border-radius:11px;color:#f6e9ca;padding:9px 14px;cursor:pointer}.navmid{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:15px;color:#e4d6b5;font-size:12px}.navmid button{background:transparent;color:#f1d38b;border:0;font-size:18px;cursor:pointer}.slidecount{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;letter-spacing:.1em}.progress{position:absolute;left:0;bottom:0;height:3px;background:#c9a35e;width:0%;transition:width .22s}#help{position:absolute;top:12px;right:18px;color:rgba(240,225,191,.55);font-size:10px;z-index:90}
@media(max-width:800px){.panel,.answer-panel{left:3vw;width:94vw;height:88vh;top:4vh;padding:18px}.qslide h2{font-size:20px}.options{gap:8px;margin-top:2vh}.option{font-size:12px;min-height:95px;padding:10px}.timer{right:4vw;top:1vh;width:68px;height:62px}.timer .time{font-size:23px}.answer-panel{width:94vw}.answer-letter{font-size:34px}.explain{font-size:15px}.cover-panel{left:3vw;top:10vh;width:94vw;height:77vh;padding:30px}.cover h1{font-size:54px}.cover-sub{font-size:15px}.steps span{font-size:14px}.closing .end-panel{width:94vw;height:80vh;top:8vh}.closing h2{font-size:33px}.closing p{font-size:16px}}

/* ===== REVISION: MIDNIGHT / ANTIQUE GOLD PALETTE ===== */
:root{--gold:#e9c77e;--cream:#f5eddf;--muted:#c9c2b5;--deep:#0a101a;--line:#b78a47}
html,body,#deck{background:#050811;color:var(--cream)}
.slide{background-color:#0a101a}
.image-slide{background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(6,10,18,.66),rgba(7,12,21,.43)),var(--bg);background-size:cover;background-position:center}
.panel{background:rgba(8,14,25,.92);border-color:rgba(204,166,94,.62);box-shadow:0 18px 58px rgba(0,0,0,.42)}
.option{border-color:rgba(188,151,88,.56);background:rgba(13,19,31,.94)}
.option i{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#f0d48f,#9d7136);color:#131924}
.timer{background:rgba(9,15,26,.94)}


.cover{background:#050811}
.river{filter:sepia(.22) saturate(1.08) hue-rotate(-7deg) contrast(1.10) brightness(.98)}
.cover-vignette{background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(5,7,13,.26),rgba(6,8,14,.08) 48%,rgba(5,7,13,.23) 100%),linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(4,6,11,.28),transparent 26%,transparent 72%,rgba(4,6,11,.22))}
.cover-panel{left:21vw;top:4.5vh;width:58vw;max-width:900px;height:21vh;min-height:160px;background:rgba(7,11,19,.73);border:1px solid rgba(230,195,120,.78);border-radius:20px;padding:1.8vh 2vw;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 14px 42px rgba(0,0,0,.36);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);z-index:12}
.cover .eyebrow{font-size:clamp(9px,.8vw,13px);letter-spacing:.26em;margin-bottom:.7vh;color:#f0d492}
.cover h1{font-size:clamp(32px,3.85vw,60px);line-height:.96;margin:.5vh 0 .7vh;color:#fff1cf;text-shadow:0 3px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.cover h1 span{color:#f0c96e}
.cover-sub{font-size:clamp(12px,1.18vw,19px);letter-spacing:.22em}
.cover-author{font-size:clamp(8px,.72vw,11px);margin-top:.65vh;letter-spacing:.19em;color:#e1d4bb}
.cover .goldbtn{margin-top:1vh;padding:9px 18px;font-size:11px;border:1px solid rgba(255,236,183,.65)}
.river-caption{right:2.8vw;bottom:1.7vh;font-size:9px;color:#f3d89c;text-shadow:0 2px 9px #000;z-index:15}
/* Historical scholars frame both banks; the river stays visible in the middle. */
.scholar-gallery{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:10;pointer-events:none}
.scholar-card{position:absolute;display:flex;flex-direction:column;width:13.1vw;height:30vh;min-width:142px;max-width:230px;min-height:210px;max-height:330px;text-decoration:none;pointer-events:auto;border:1px solid rgba(234,198,126,.82);border-radius:15px;padding:5px;background:linear-gradient(155deg,rgba(23,20,17,.86),rgba(5,9,16,.94));box-shadow:0 12px 38px rgba(0,0,0,.5),0 0 26px rgba(226,178,91,.10);overflow:hidden}
.scholar-card:before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:4px;border:1px solid rgba(238,210,151,.25);border-radius:10px;pointer-events:none;z-index:2}
.scholar-card-1{left:2.7vw;top:25vh}
.scholar-card-2{left:2.7vw;top:59vh}
.scholar-card-3{right:2.7vw;top:25vh}
.scholar-card-4{right:2.7vw;top:59vh}
.portrait-image{display:block;position:relative;flex:1;min-height:0;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;background:#171717}
.portrait-image img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 25%;display:block;filter:sepia(.12) saturate(.86) contrast(1.04)}
.scholar-card-2 .portrait-image img{object-position:center 18%}
.scholar-card-3 .portrait-image img{object-position:center 20%}
.scholar-card-4 .portrait-image img{object-position:center 15%}
.portrait-label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;text-align:center;padding:7px 3px 5px;color:#f3dfb1;line-height:1.15}
.portrait-label strong{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:clamp(12px,1.05vw,16px);letter-spacing:.02em}
.portrait-label small{font-size:clamp(8px,.62vw,10px);color:#d0bd98;letter-spacing:.06em}
.portrait-credit{position:absolute;left:19vw;bottom:1.7vh;z-index:15;color:rgba(245,222,177,.76);font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-shadow:0 2px 6px #000}

@media(max-width:800px){
 .cover-panel{left:19vw;top:4vh;width:62vw;height:auto;min-height:150px;padding:16px 12px}
 .cover h1{font-size:38px}.cover-sub{font-size:12px}.cover-author{font-size:8px}
 .scholar-card{width:18vw;height:23vh;min-width:92px;min-height:145px}
 .scholar-card-1{left:1.2vw;top:29vh}.scholar-card-2{left:1.2vw;top:56vh}
 .scholar-card-3{right:1.2vw;top:29vh}.scholar-card-4{right:1.2vw;top:56vh}
 .portrait-credit{left:20vw;right:20vw;text-align:center;font-size:6px;bottom:1vh}
 .river-caption{display:none}
}

/* Five-question advanced version: keep the long distractors readable and within the panel. */
.qpanel h2{font-size:clamp(21px,2.0vw,33px);line-height:1.16;margin-bottom:2.1vh}
.qpanel .options{gap:12px;margin-top:2.0vh}
.qpanel .option{font-size:clamp(12px,1.02vw,16px);line-height:1.30;min-height:clamp(86px,12vh,118px);padding:14px 14px}
.answer-panel .explain{font-size:clamp(15px,1.16vw,19px);line-height:1.55}

/* Final countdown: prominent, high-contrast, always visible on question slides. */
.slide[data-kind="question"] .timer{position:absolute!important;z-index:80!important;right:3.2vw!important;top:2.2vh!important;width:92px!important;height:84px!important;border:2px solid #f0c56c!important;border-radius:18px!important;background:rgba(18,11,5,.97)!important;box-shadow:0 0 0 5px rgba(228,174,81,.10),0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.40)!important;display:flex!important;visibility:visible!important;opacity:1!important}
.slide[data-kind="question"] .time{font-size:38px!important;line-height:1!important;color:#ffe4a2!important;font-weight:950!important}
.slide[data-kind="question"] .timer small{font-size:10px!important;letter-spacing:.22em!important;color:#f5dca6!important}
.slide[data-kind="question"] .timerline{width:68px!important;height:5px!important;margin-top:4px!important}
.slide[data-kind="question"] .timerline b{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#fff2bb,#e6a53f)!important}

#audio-autoplay-hint{position:absolute;z-index:40;right:18px;top:16px;max-width:min(420px,calc(100vw - 36px));padding:9px 12px;border:1px solid rgba(230,197,127,.65);border-radius:10px;background:rgba(3,11,10,.86);color:#f1e9d6;font-size:12px;line-height:1.4;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 6px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}#audio-autoplay-hint[hidden]{display:none}</style><style>
:root{--gold:#f2c66d;--cream:#fff0d0;--muted:#cbbba0;--deep:#120b06;--line:#a9752b}
html,body,#deck{background:#070402!important;color:#fff0d0!important}
.slide{background-color:#120b06!important}
.image-slide{background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(12,7,3,.53),rgba(10,6,3,.3)),var(--bg)!important}
.panel,.answer-panel{background:rgba(19,11,5,.91)!important;border-color:rgba(231,183,91,.7)!important;box-shadow:0 18px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.52)!important}
.options .option{appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none;text-align:left;width:100%;cursor:pointer;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(43,27,12,.96),rgba(24,15,8,.97))!important;border:1px solid rgba(205,156,76,.62)!important;color:#fff1d3!important;transition:transform .16s ease,border-color .16s ease,background .16s ease;}
.options .option:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:#f3ca74!important;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(77,48,18,.98),rgba(37,22,9,.98))!important}
.options .option:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #ffe09a;outline-offset:3px}
.options .option.is-picked{border:2px solid #ffe29b!important;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(91,60,25,.98),rgba(38,24,10,.98))!important}
.timer{background:rgba(24,14,6,.93)!important;border-color:rgba(242,198,109,.85)!important;box-shadow:0 0 35px rgba(228,164,61,.15)}
.timer .time{color:#ffe19a!important;text-shadow:0 0 16px rgba(255,197,85,.35)}
.timerline{background:#4d3518!important}.timerline b{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#fff0b7,#e5a640)!important}
.qfoot{color:#dfc18b!important}
.eyebrow,.why,.meme-head{color:#f1c46d!important}
.answer-letter{color:#ffdc91!important}
.correct,.explain{color:#fff0d5!important}
#chrome{background:rgba(8,5,3,.9)!important;border-color:rgba(194,145,62,.42)!important}
.navbtn,#next,#home,#prev,#fs{color:#f5d590!important}
.scholar-card{filter:sepia(.18) saturate(.9)}
.scholar-label,.portrait-label{color:#f6dfae!important}
.response-result{font-size:clamp(15px,1.15vw,19px);font-weight:950;letter-spacing:.18em;margin:0 0 1.1vh;color:#f2c66d;text-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(239,177,72,.22)}
.response-result.is-wrong{color:#f19a78}
#meme-stage{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:99999;display:none;background:#050302;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
#meme-stage.active{display:flex}
#meme-player{width:100vw;height:100vh;border:0;background:#050302;display:block}
#meme-overlay{position:absolute;z-index:100001;left:50%;bottom:clamp(16px,4vh,42px);transform:translateX(-50%);width:min(760px,calc(100vw - 32px));padding:13px 18px 12px;border:1px solid rgba(230,197,127,.78);border-radius:15px;background:rgba(3,15,13,.88);color:#f4ead4;text-align:center;pointer-events:none;backdrop-filter:blur(8px);box-shadow:0 10px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.36)}
#meme-reaction{font-size:clamp(10px,1vw,13px);font-weight:950;letter-spacing:.14em;color:#f2cf84}
#meme-caption{margin-top:5px;font-size:clamp(14px,1.55vw,22px);line-height:1.25;font-weight:850}
#meme-source{margin-top:5px;font-size:10px;line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:.06em;color:#c5d0c7}
#timeout-meme{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:100002;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:24px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 35%,rgba(43,74,62,.72),rgba(3,10,9,.97) 72%);color:#f5ecd8;text-align:center}
#timeout-meme.active{display:flex}
.timeout-card{width:min(760px,92vw);padding:clamp(24px,5vw,58px);border:1px solid rgba(230,197,127,.65);border-radius:24px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(23,43,34,.96),rgba(7,17,15,.97));box-shadow:0 20px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.46);overflow:hidden}
.timeout-kicker{color:#e6c57f;font-size:clamp(10px,1vw,14px);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.22em}
.timeout-emoji{font-size:clamp(56px,9vw,112px);line-height:1.2;margin:16px 0;display:inline-block;filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.35))}
.timeout-headline{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(26px,4vw,48px);line-height:1.1;color:#f4e3b6}
.timeout-caption{margin:14px auto 0;max-width:590px;color:#d2d8cb;font-size:clamp(14px,1.6vw,20px);line-height:1.45}
.timeout-meter{width:min(420px,80%);height:9px;margin:28px auto 0;border-radius:99px;background:rgba(230,197,127,.18);overflow:hidden}
.timeout-meter span{display:block;height:100%;width:100%;transform-origin:left;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#e6c57f,#8cbb9c);animation:timeout-progress 4.2s linear forwards}
.timeout-meme.slow .timeout-emoji{animation:timeout-bob 1.1s ease-in-out infinite}
.timeout-meme.brain .timeout-emoji{animation:timeout-spin 2.4s ease-in-out infinite}
.timeout-meme.brain .timeout-card{animation:timeout-pulse .8s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes timeout-progress{from{transform:scaleX(1)}to{transform:scaleX(0)}}
@keyframes timeout-bob{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(-5deg)}50%{transform:translateY(-13px) rotate(5deg)}}
@keyframes timeout-spin{0%,100%{transform:rotate(-12deg) scale(1)}50%{transform:rotate(12deg) scale(1.08)}}
@keyframes timeout-pulse{from{border-color:rgba(230,197,127,.45)}to{border-color:rgba(230,197,127,.95)}}
@media(max-width:640px){#meme-overlay{width:calc(100vw - 20px);bottom:12px;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:12px}#meme-caption{font-size:14px}#meme-source{font-size:9px}}
.start{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f9d98a,#ba7d2f)!important;color:#1b1006!important}
</style><style id="cover-motion-system">
/* Keep the original moving river video. Decorate only the banks and outer edges. */
.cover{isolation:isolate;background:#061715}
.cover .river{display:block!important;visibility:visible!important;opacity:1!important;position:absolute!important;inset:0!important;width:100%!important;height:100%!important;object-fit:cover!important;z-index:0!important;filter:sepia(.16) saturate(1.12) hue-rotate(-5deg) contrast(1.07) brightness(1.02)!important}
.cover-landscape{display:none!important}
.cover-vignette{z-index:3;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(2,12,9,.14),rgba(5,14,11,.015) 48%,rgba(2,12,9,.14)),linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(4,10,8,.18),transparent 25%,transparent 78%,rgba(4,10,8,.08))}
.cover-bank-decor{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:6;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none}
.cover-motion{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:7;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none}
.cover-bank-decor svg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
.cover-bank-decor .tree-left,.cover-bank-decor .tree-right{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:bottom center;animation:bank-tree-sway 8.5s ease-in-out infinite alternate;will-change:transform}
.cover-bank-decor .tree-right{animation-duration:9.2s;animation-direction:alternate-reverse}
.cover-bank-decor .leaf-group{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center;animation:bank-leaf-sway 4.5s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.cover-bank-decor .leaf-group.delay{animation-delay:-2s;animation-duration:5.6s}
.cover-bank-decor .flower-group{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center;animation:flower-sway 6s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.cover-bank-decor .bank-vine{stroke-dasharray:5 3;animation:vine-sway 10s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.cover-petal{position:absolute;top:-8%;left:var(--x);width:var(--w,10px);height:var(--h,7px);border-radius:95% 8% 95% 8%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff4dc,#efa3a8 62%,#bd6f76);box-shadow:0 0 9px rgba(255,206,190,.35);opacity:0;animation:petal-fall var(--duration,15s) linear var(--delay,0s) infinite}
.cover-petal.gold{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff4c8,#e9bd68 70%,#a87b36)}
.cover-firefly{position:absolute;width:4px;height:4px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff2bd;box-shadow:0 0 7px 3px rgba(255,215,128,.58),0 0 18px 6px rgba(255,191,80,.24);opacity:0;animation:firefly-glow var(--duration,5s) ease-in-out var(--delay,0s) infinite}
.cover-panel{position:absolute!important;left:50%!important;top:2vh!important;transform:translateX(-50%);width:min(74vw,1020px)!important;max-width:1020px!important;height:auto!important;min-height:0!important;padding:clamp(10px,1.2vh,16px) clamp(14px,2vw,26px)!important;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(7,21,17,.85),rgba(12,23,20,.76))!important;border:1px solid rgba(240,207,137,.84)!important;box-shadow:0 14px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.37),0 0 0 5px rgba(226,190,112,.08),0 0 35px rgba(244,199,105,.13)!important;backdrop-filter:blur(8px) saturate(1.2)!important;animation:cover-panel-arrive 1.1s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) both}
.cover-panel:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:6px;border:1px solid rgba(255,231,178,.20);border-radius:9px;pointer-events:none}
.cover-panel:after{content:"";position:absolute;top:-45%;left:-35%;width:30%;height:190%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,237,192,.11),transparent);transform:rotate(20deg);animation:cover-card-glint 8s ease-in-out 1s infinite}
.cover h1{font-size:clamp(30px,4.35vw,58px)!important;margin:.25vh 0 .55vh!important;line-height:.98!important}
.cover .eyebrow{font-size:clamp(8px,.72vw,11px)!important;margin-bottom:.35vh!important;letter-spacing:.22em!important;color:#e9cb87!important}
.cover .cover-sub{font-size:clamp(10px,.95vw,14px)!important;margin-top:.15vh!important}
.cover .cover-author{font-size:clamp(8px,.66vw,10px)!important;margin-top:.45vh!important}
.cover .goldbtn.start{margin-top:.65vh!important;padding:8px 17px!important;font-size:10px!important;position:relative;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid rgba(255,242,201,.65);box-shadow:0 7px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.34),0 0 20px rgba(240,194,103,.22);animation:start-button-pulse 2.8s ease-in-out infinite}
.cover .goldbtn.start:after{content:"";position:absolute;top:-30%;left:-55%;width:35%;height:160%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.40);transform:skewX(-25deg);animation:button-sheen 4.5s ease-in-out infinite}
.cover .scholar-card{width:clamp(104px,10.4vw,148px)!important;height:clamp(136px,24vh,188px)!important;min-width:104px!important;min-height:136px!important;max-width:148px!important;max-height:188px!important;padding:4px!important;border-radius:13px!important;background:linear-gradient(155deg,rgba(23,20,17,.82),rgba(5,9,16,.82))!important;box-shadow:0 9px 27px rgba(0,0,0,.36),0 0 18px rgba(226,178,91,.08)!important;animation:scholar-card-float 7s ease-in-out infinite}
.cover .scholar-card-1{left:1.7vw!important;top:29vh!important}
.cover .scholar-card-2{left:1.7vw!important;top:59vh!important}
.cover .scholar-card-3{right:1.7vw!important;top:29vh!important}
.cover .scholar-card-4{right:1.7vw!important;top:59vh!important}
.cover .scholar-card-2{animation-delay:-2s}.cover .scholar-card-3{animation-delay:-3.2s}.cover .scholar-card-4{animation-delay:-4.4s}
.cover .portrait-label{padding:4px 2px 3px!important}
.cover .portrait-label strong{font-size:clamp(11px,.9vw,13px)!important}
.cover .portrait-label small{font-size:clamp(8px,.65vw,10px)!important}
.cover .river-caption{z-index:9;bottom:2.2vh!important;right:2.2vw!important;color:#f5dfa8!important;text-shadow:0 2px 10px #000}
@keyframes bank-tree-sway{0%{transform:rotate(-1deg) translateY(0)}100%{transform:rotate(1.1deg) translateY(-3px)}}
@keyframes bank-leaf-sway{0%{transform:rotate(-3deg)}100%{transform:rotate(3.5deg)}}
@keyframes flower-sway{0%{transform:rotate(-2deg) translateY(0)}100%{transform:rotate(3deg) translateY(-2px)}}
@keyframes vine-sway{0%{stroke-dashoffset:0;transform:translateY(0)}100%{stroke-dashoffset:26;transform:translateY(5px)}}
@keyframes petal-fall{0%{transform:translate3d(0,-5vh,0) rotate(0deg);opacity:0}12%{opacity:.85}78%{opacity:.72}100%{transform:translate3d(5vw,110vh,0) rotate(520deg);opacity:0}}
@keyframes firefly-glow{0%,100%{opacity:0;transform:translate3d(0,0,0) scale(.6)}50%{opacity:.95;transform:translate3d(13px,-18px,0) scale(1.35)}}
@keyframes scholar-card-float{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-5px)}}
@keyframes cover-panel-arrive{from{opacity:0;translate:0 -12px}to{opacity:1;translate:0 0}}
@keyframes cover-card-glint{0%,35%{left:-40%}58%,100%{left:125%}}
@keyframes start-button-pulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 7px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.34),0 0 12px rgba(240,194,103,.17)}50%{box-shadow:0 7px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.42),0 0 25px rgba(240,194,103,.38)}}
@keyframes button-sheen{0%,60%{left:-55%}85%,100%{left:135%}}
@media(max-width:800px){
 .cover-panel{width:min(91vw,760px)!important;top:1.5vh!important;padding:10px 12px!important}
 .cover h1{font-size:clamp(29px,7vw,42px)!important}
 .cover .scholar-card{width:clamp(90px,18vw,130px)!important;height:clamp(115px,21vh,154px)!important;min-width:90px!important;min-height:115px!important}
 .cover .scholar-card-1{left:1vw!important;top:32vh!important}
 .cover .scholar-card-2{left:1vw!important;top:59vh!important}
 .cover .scholar-card-3{right:1vw!important;top:32vh!important}
 .cover .scholar-card-4{right:1vw!important;top:59vh!important}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
 .cover-bank-decor .tree-left,.cover-bank-decor .tree-right,.cover-bank-decor .leaf-group,.cover-bank-decor .flower-group,.cover-petal,.cover-firefly,.cover-panel,.cover .goldbtn.start,.cover .goldbtn.start:after,.cover .scholar-card{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}
}
</style><style id="cover-hillside-motion">
.cover-bank-decor .hill-slope{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:bottom center}
.cover-bank-decor .hill-far{animation:hill-breeze 16s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.cover-bank-decor .hill-mid{animation:hill-breeze 12s ease-in-out infinite alternate-reverse}
.cover-bank-decor .hill-front{animation:hill-breeze 18s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.cover-bank-decor .hill-tree{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:bottom center;animation:hill-tree-sway 7s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.cover-bank-decor .hill-mist{animation:hill-mist-drift 18s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes hill-breeze{0%{transform:translateY(0)}100%{transform:translateY(-3px)}}
@keyframes hill-tree-sway{0%{transform:rotate(-.8deg)}100%{transform:rotate(.9deg)}}
@keyframes hill-mist-drift{0%{transform:translateX(-2%);opacity:.24}100%{transform:translateX(4%);opacity:.58}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.cover-bank-decor .hill-slope,.cover-bank-decor .hill-tree,.cover-bank-decor .hill-mist{animation:none!important}}
</style><style id="cover-bright-waterfall-banks">
.cover-bank-decor{position:absolute!important;inset:0!important;z-index:8!important;display:block!important;visibility:visible!important;opacity:1!important;overflow:hidden!important;pointer-events:none!important}
.cover-bank-decor svg{position:absolute!important;inset:0!important;width:100%!important;height:100%!important;display:block!important;visibility:visible!important;opacity:1!important;z-index:8!important}
.cover .river{z-index:0!important;display:block!important;visibility:visible!important;opacity:1!important}
.cover-vignette{z-index:3!important;opacity:.48!important}
.cover-bank-decor .slope-trees{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:bottom center;animation:mountain-trees-sway 7.5s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.cover-bank-decor .waterfall-stream{stroke-dasharray:28 17;animation:waterfall-run 1.15s linear infinite}
.cover-bank-decor .waterfall-stream.thin{animation-duration:.8s;animation-direction:reverse}
.cover-bank-decor .waterfall-spray{animation:waterfall-mist 2.8s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes waterfall-run{from{stroke-dashoffset:0}to{stroke-dashoffset:-90}}
@keyframes waterfall-mist{from{opacity:.24;transform:translateY(1px) scale(.9)}to{opacity:.72;transform:translateY(-5px) scale(1.08)}}
@keyframes mountain-trees-sway{from{transform:rotate(-.8deg)}to{transform:rotate(.9deg)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.cover-bank-decor .slope-trees,.cover-bank-decor .waterfall-stream,.cover-bank-decor .waterfall-spray{animation:none!important}}
</style></head><body><main id="deck"><section class="slide cover" data-kind="cover">
